## Summary of Changes Hello, I'm Gemini Code Assist[^1]! I'm currently reviewing this pull request and will post my feedback shortly. In the meantime, here's a summary to help you and other reviewers quickly get up to speed! This pull request significantly enhances the Filer's interaction with remote storage by introducing automated background metadata synchronization and intelligent Time-To-Live (TTL) based revalidation for remote entries. These features aim to improve data consistency, reduce operational overhead by replacing manual sync jobs, and enhance availability by gracefully handling remote errors. Additionally, it enables dynamic reloading of remote storage configurations and refines directory listing behavior for remote mounts. ### Highlights * **Background Metadata Synchronization**: Introduced a new `-remoteMetaSyncInterval` flag (defaulting to 0 for disabled) that, when enabled, starts a background goroutine. This goroutine periodically traverses all configured remote mounts and automatically upserts new or changed remote entries into the local Filer store, eliminating the need for external cron jobs for metadata synchronization. * **Remote Entry Time-To-Live (TTL) and Revalidation**: Added a new `-remoteEntryTTL` flag (defaulting to 0 for disabled) to manage the freshness of cached remote entries. When a stale entry is accessed via `FindEntry`, the Filer now re-stats the remote object. If the remote object is unchanged, its local sync timestamp is refreshed. If it has changed, its chunks are cleared to force a re-fetch on subsequent reads. If the remote object has been deleted, the local entry is removed. Crucially, in cases of remote errors during revalidation, the stale local entry is served to maintain availability (stale-while-error). * **Remote Configuration Reloading**: Implemented dynamic reloading of remote storage configurations and mappings. Changes to files within the `/etc/remote` directory now trigger an automatic reset and reload of the Filer's remote storage settings, allowing for configuration updates without a Filer restart. * **Enhanced Directory Listing for Remote Mounts**: Improved the `doListDirectoryEntries` function to merge remote listings with local entries when a directory is under a remote mount. This ensures that directory listings reflect both locally cached and newly discovered remote files, with new remote entries being asynchronously persisted to the local store. 🧠 **New Feature in Public Preview:** You can now enable **Memory** to help **Gemini Code Assist** learn from your team's feedback. This makes future code reviews more consistent and personalized to your project's style. **Click [here](https://codeassist.google/code-review/login) to enable Memory in your admin console.**
Changelog * **weed/command/filer.go** * Added `remoteMetaSyncInterval` and `remoteEntryTTL` fields to `FilerOptions`. * Initialized new command-line flags for `remoteMetaSyncInterval` and `remoteEntryTTL`. * Passed new remote synchronization and TTL options to the Filer during startup. * **weed/filer/filer.go** * Added `RemoteMetaSyncer` and `RemoteEntryTTL` fields to the `Filer` struct. * Integrated remote entry revalidation logic into `FindEntry` based on `RemoteEntryTTL`. * Ensured network errors from remote `StatFile` calls are propagated correctly in `maybeLazyFetchFromRemote`. * Modified `doListDirectoryEntries` to include merging of remote listings and tracking local entry names. * Added `RemoteMetaSyncer` shutdown call to the Filer's `Shutdown` method. * **weed/filer/filer_lazy_remote.go** * Modified `maybeLazyFetchFromRemote` to propagate network errors from remote `StatFile` calls. * **weed/filer/filer_lazy_remote_test.go** * Extended `stubRemoteClient` with `listDirResult` and `listDirErr` for directory listing tests. * Implemented `ListDirectory` method for `stubRemoteClient`. * Added tests for error propagation in `maybeLazyFetchFromRemote` and `FindEntry`. * **weed/filer/filer_on_meta_event.go** * Implemented logic to reload remote storage configurations and mappings upon changes in `/etc/remote`. * **weed/filer/filer_on_meta_event_test.go** * Added tests to verify remote storage configuration reloading triggered by `/etc/remote` events. * Tested the `Reset` functionality of `FilerRemoteStorage` and its impact on mounts. * Verified `FindMountDirectory` and `FindRemoteStorageClient` behavior after mount changes. * **weed/filer/filer_remote_listing.go** * Added `maybeMergeRemoteListings` function to fetch and persist remote entries not present locally during directory listings. * Introduced `buildRemoteOnlyEntry` to create Filer `Entry` objects from remote listing data. * Added `persistRemoteListingEntry` for asynchronous persistence of new remote entries. * **weed/filer/filer_remote_listing_test.go** * Added comprehensive tests for `maybeMergeRemoteListings` covering various scenarios like adding new entries, deduplication, error handling, prefix filtering, and pagination. * Included tests for `buildRemoteOnlyEntry` for both file and directory types. * **weed/filer/filer_remote_meta_syncer.go** * Introduced `RemoteMetaSyncer` struct to manage background metadata synchronization. * Implemented `StartRemoteMetaSyncer` and `Stop` methods for the syncer. * Defined `loop` for periodic synchronization and `syncAllMounts` to process all remote mounts. * Implemented `syncOneMount` to traverse remote storage, create new local entries, and update changed ones. * **weed/filer/filer_remote_meta_syncer_test.go** * Added tests for `RemoteMetaSyncer` to verify creation and update of entries, skipping local-only entries, and proper shutdown. * Introduced `traverseStubClient` for simulating remote traversal in tests. * Added a test for `GetAllMountMappings` functionality. * **weed/filer/filer_remote_revalidation.go** * Added `remoteEntryNeedsRevalidation` to determine if a remote entry's cache is stale. * Implemented `revalidateRemoteEntry` to re-stat remote objects, update local metadata, clear chunks if changed, delete if removed, or serve stale on errors. * **weed/filer/filer_remote_revalidation_test.go** * Added tests for `remoteEntryNeedsRevalidation` covering fresh, stale, and disabled TTL scenarios. * Included tests for `revalidateRemoteEntry` to verify behavior for unchanged, changed, deleted, and error conditions (serving stale data). * **weed/filer/remote_storage.go** * Added a `Reset` method to `FilerRemoteStorage` to clear its internal state. * Introduced `GetAllMountMappings` to retrieve a map of all configured remote mount points. * **weed/remote_storage/azure/azure_storage_client.go** * Added a placeholder `ListDirectory` method to conform to the updated `RemoteStorageClient` interface. * **weed/remote_storage/gcs/gcs_storage_client.go** * Added a placeholder `ListDirectory` method to conform to the updated `RemoteStorageClient` interface. * **weed/remote_storage/remote_storage.go** * Defined `RemoteListing` struct to represent a single entry in a remote directory listing. * Added `ListDirectory` method to the `RemoteStorageClient` interface for single-level directory listings. * **weed/remote_storage/s3/s3_storage_client.go** * Implemented the `ListDirectory` method for S3 remote storage clients, utilizing `ListObjectsV2Pages` with delimiters. * **weed/server/filer_server.go** * Added `RemoteMetaSyncInterval` and `RemoteEntryTTL` to `FilerOption`. * Integrated the starting of the `RemoteMetaSyncer` and setting of `RemoteEntryTTL` into the Filer server initialization process.
Using Gemini Code Assist
The full guide for Gemini Code Assist can be found on our [documentation page](https://developers.google.com/gemini-code-assist/docs/review-github-code), here are some quick tips. Invoking Gemini You can request assistance from Gemini at any point by creating a comment using either `/gemini ` or `@gemini-code-assist `. Below is a summary of the supported commands on the current page. Feature | Command | Description --- | --- | --- Code Review | `/gemini review` | Performs a code review for the current pull request in its current state. Pull Request Summary | `/gemini summary` | Provides a summary of the current pull request in its current state. Comment | @gemini-code-assist | Responds in comments when explicitly tagged, both in pull request comments and review comments. Help | `/gemini help` | Displays a list of available commands. Customization To customize Gemini Code Assist for GitHub experience, repository maintainers can create a configuration file and/or provide a custom code review style guide (such as PEP-8 for Python) by creating and adding files to a `.gemini/` folder in the base of the repository. Detailed instructions can be found [here](https://developers.google.com/gemini-code-assist/docs/customize-gemini-behavior-github). Limitations & Feedback Gemini Code Assist may make mistakes. Please leave feedback on any instances where its feedback is incorrect or counter productive. You can react with :thumbsup: and :thumbsdown: on @gemini-code-assist comments. If you're interested in giving your feedback about your experience with Gemini Code Assist for Github and other Google products, sign up [here](https://google.qualtrics.com/jfe/form/SV_2cyuGuTWsEw84yG). You can also get AI-powered code generation, chat, as well as code reviews directly in the IDE at no cost with the [Gemini Code Assist IDE Extension](https://cloud.google.com/products/gemini/code-assist).
[^1]: Review the [Privacy Notices](https://policies.google.com/privacy), [Generative AI Prohibited Use Policy](https://policies.google.com/terms/generative-ai/use-policy), [Terms of Service](https://policies.google.com/terms), and learn how to configure Gemini Code Assist in GitHub [here](https://developers.google.com/gemini-code-assist/docs/customize-gemini-behavior-github). Gemini can make mistakes, so double check it and [use code with caution](https://support.google.com/legal/answer/13505487).

📝 Walkthrough ## Walkthrough Adds remote metadata sync, per-entry TTL revalidation, remote-aware directory listing and runtime remote-config reload; exposes ListDirectory in remote clients and wires remote sync/TTL options into server startup. ## Changes |Cohort / File(s)|Summary| |---|---| |**Configuration & Server Wiring**
`weed/command/filer.go`, `weed/server/filer_server.go`|Added CLI/server options for remote meta sync interval and remote-entry TTL; wired options to start RemoteMetaSyncer and set Filer.RemoteEntryTTL.| |**Filer core & listing**
`weed/filer/filer.go`, `weed/filer/filer_remote_listing.go`, `weed/filer/filer_remote_listing_test.go`|Added RemoteMetaSyncer/RemoteEntryTTL fields; doListDirectoryEntries now merges remote listings; remote-only entries are built and persisted asynchronously; tests for merging and dedupe.| |**Lazy fetch / FindEntry flow**
`weed/filer/filer_lazy_remote.go`, `weed/filer/filer_lazy_remote_test.go`|Changed error propagation in maybeLazyFetchFromRemote; FindEntry revalidation path improved to propagate remote errors and incorporate revalidation results; tests added for error propagation and not-found handling.| |**Remote entry revalidation**
`weed/filer/filer_remote_revalidation.go`, `weed/filer/filer_remote_revalidation_test.go`|New revalidation decision and revalidateRemoteEntry implementation (TTL-based); handles unchanged/changed/not-found/err cases and updates or deletes local entries accordingly with tests.| |**Remote meta syncer**
`weed/filer/filer_remote_meta_syncer.go`, `weed/filer/filer_remote_meta_syncer_test.go`|Introduced RemoteMetaSyncer with periodic loop to sync mounts, create/update remote entries, and stop mechanism; covered by tests including stop/skip-local-only cases.| |**Runtime remote config reload & storage management**
`weed/filer/filer_on_meta_event.go`, `weed/filer/filer_on_meta_event_test.go`, `weed/filer/remote_storage.go`|Implemented reload path for remote storage config on metadata events; added thread-safety (mutex), Reset and GetAllMountMappings for FilerRemoteStorage; tests for reload and mapping behavior.| |**Remote storage interface & clients**
`weed/remote_storage/remote_storage.go`, `weed/remote_storage/s3/s3_storage_client.go`, `weed/remote_storage/gcs/gcs_storage_client.go`, `weed/remote_storage/azure/azure_storage_client.go`|Added RemoteListing type and ListDirectory method to RemoteStorageClient interface; S3 implements listing, GCS/Azure stubs added (return nil).| |**Filer public structs & shutdown**
`weed/filer/filer.go`|Added exported fields `RemoteMetaSyncer *RemoteMetaSyncer` and `RemoteEntryTTL time.Duration`; Filer.Shutdown stops syncer.| ## Sequence Diagram(s) ```mermaid sequenceDiagram participant Client participant Filer participant LocalStore participant RemoteClient Client->>Filer: FindEntry(path) Filer->>LocalStore: lookup entry LocalStore-->>Filer: entry (may have Remote metadata) alt entry.Remote == nil Filer-->>Client: return entry else Filer->>Filer: remoteEntryNeedsRevalidation? alt needs revalidation Filer->>RemoteClient: Stat(remote path) RemoteClient-->>Filer: remote stat / not-found / error alt remote not found Filer->>LocalStore: delete entry Filer-->>Client: ErrNotFound else remote stat success alt unchanged Filer->>LocalStore: update LastLocalSyncTsNs Filer-->>Client: return entry else changed Filer->>LocalStore: update entry (size, mtime, etag), clear chunks Filer-->>Client: return updated entry end else stat error Filer-->>Client: return stale entry (no revalidation) end else Filer-->>Client: return entry end end ``` ```mermaid sequenceDiagram participant Timer participant RemoteMetaSyncer participant Filer participant RemoteClient participant LocalStore Timer->>RemoteMetaSyncer: tick RemoteMetaSyncer->>Filer: syncAllMounts() loop per mount Filer->>RemoteClient: Traverse/List remote entries RemoteClient-->>Filer: entries loop per remote entry Filer->>LocalStore: FindEntry(mapped local path) LocalStore-->>Filer: existing or nil alt no local entry Filer->>LocalStore: create remote-only entry (lazy) else local-only Note over Filer: skip overwrite else remote newer Filer->>LocalStore: update entry (clear chunks) end end end ``` ## Estimated code review effort 🎯 4 (Complex) | ⏱️ ~60 minutes ## Possibly related PRs - seaweedfs/seaweedfs#7426: Overlaps with FindEntry and doListDirectoryEntries changes (revalidation/list merging). - seaweedfs/seaweedfs#8454: Related lazy-fetch and remote revalidation edits (maybeLazyFetchFromRemote / FindEntry). - seaweedfs/seaweedfs#7485: Touches directory-listing callback and listing control flow similar to merge logic here. ## Suggested reviewers - chrislusf ## Poem > 🐇 I hopped through mounts both near and far, > > syncing etags beneath the star, > > listings stitched from sea and land, > > TTL checks at my pawed command, > > a little rabbit, syncing your shard.

The required threshold is 80.00%. | Write docstrings for the functions missing them to satisfy the coverage threshold. | | Description check | ❓ Inconclusive | The description covers the main features and includes a test plan checklist, but the checklist items are marked incomplete and lack details on actual testing performed or implementation specifics. | Complete the test plan checklist with specific results or remove incomplete items. Add more details about how each feature was validated and tested before merging. |
✅ Passed checks (1 passed) | Check name | Status | Explanation | | :---------: | :------- | :---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- | | Title check | ✅ Passed | The title accurately summarizes the two main features: background metadata sync and entry TTL for remote storage, which align with the primary changes in the PR. |

# Transforming Code Reviews with AI

## Features

**Automated Reviews**: Continuous reviews of the pull requests including incremental commits. 

**Summarization**: Generates high-level summary and a technical walkthrough of the PR changes. 

**Line-by-line review**: Provides line-by-line suggestions committable with one click.

**Codebase verification**:  Verifies the impact on the overall codebase and identifies missing changes.

**Insights into your code**:  Ask any questions on your codebase within the pull request 

**Chat about your code** : Chat with the bot around your code. The more you chat, the smarter it gets.

**Issue Validation**:  Validates the PR against the linked issues and identifies other related issues
